limitations: Historical shoreline classification; not today’s shoreline or surf channels.
Accuracy and current beach width unknown.
Access points are official inventory references, not real-time opening status or directions.
Each beach’s fishing line retains only source vertices. Display stroke width is a visual emphasis, not a mapped fish-bearing zone.

properties.name: Hearst Memorial Beach · San Simeon
properties.shoreClass: NOAA ESI 3A · fine to medium-grained sandy beach
properties.geometryMethod: Contiguous original NOAA vertices selected within named beach latitude limits; no interpolation, buffers, coordinate simplification, or connections across gaps.

access.name: William R. Hearst Memorial Beach
access.note: Public beach approach at the day-use area; State Parks lists dawn-to-dusk hours. Keep clear of resting seals, respect signed closures, and recheck access on arrival. The adjacent pier license exemption does not extend onto the beach.
